qualification.education_qualification: Literate preferably matriculate, Various eligible categories including teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, NGO members, self help groups
qualification.details: Any teacher (including retired teacher), Retired Government Servants and Senior Citizens, Master of Social Welfare Students and Teachers, Anganwadi workers, Doctors/Physicians, Students and Law Students (till they enroll as lawyers), Members of Non-Political service oriented NGOs and Club, Members of Women Neighborhood Groups, Maithri Sangathans and other Self Help Groups including marginalized/vulnerable groups. Applicant should be literate, preferably matriculate with a capacity of overall comprehension. Preference to those not looking for income from PLV services but with a mindset to assist the needy.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Barnala Para-Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) post is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) post in DLSA Barnala.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) post?
faq.answer: The honorarium for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) post is Rs. 800/- per day.

faq.question: Q5. Who are the eligible categories for the Para-Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: Eligible categories include teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, NGO members, and self-help groups.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum qualification required for the Para-Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is being literate, with a preference for matriculation, and possessing a capacity for overall comprehension.

faq.question: Q8. Does DLSA Barnala offer age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age relaxation details for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Para-Legal Volunteer (Adhikar Mitra) position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form download links will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article once released.
